{{Quote|Saarcheen and I aren't pups, Tarfful! We can take care of ourselves. We want to stay here!|Barraak|<ref name="CSS" />}}
'''Barraak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]<ref name="CSS" /> of the common [[rwook]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|117|Rwook}}</ref> from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[185 BBY]], Barraak and his best friend [[Saarcheen]] accompanied three older Wookiees on an expedition in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Barraak was brutally [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Lix]], a [[Rat/Legends|rat]]-like [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] whom they encountered in the Shadowlands. His death was later avenged by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], one of his older companions, who disarmed and captured Lix and his business partners. Because he felt responsible for the pup's untimely passing, Chewbacca remained concerned about putting his friends in danger for the rest of his life.<ref name="CSS" />
